title: The Warden's Crypt
objective: Get past the crypt's doors and traps and put an end to whatever guards the warden's tomb.

rooms.name: Crypt Stair
rooms.description: Narrow steps end at a damp landing. A passage leads on into the dark, and a swollen wooden door stands shut in the side wall.

features.name: Carved Warning
features.description: Words are cut into the stone above the passage.
features.discovery: The words read: "The warden keeps the tomb. Mind the offerings."

rooms.name: Flooded Cell
rooms.description: Ankle-deep water fills a small cell. A shelf runs along the back wall above the waterline.

features.name: Wall Shelf
features.description: A stone shelf, slick with damp.
features.discovery: Behind a cracked jar on the shelf sits a stoppered vial of red liquid.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Hall of Niches
rooms.description: Burial niches line a long hall. Archways lead off to either side, and an iron door is set in the far wall beside the way to the tomb.

creatures.name: Bound Smuggler
creatures.description: A smuggler sits bound and gagged against a niche. When you pull the gag free they spit and glare at you.

topics.name: the warden
topics.reply: "I lifted the sarcophagus lid and the warden climbed out after me. My partners left me tied here. Go and see for yourself."

topics.name: the iron key
topics.reply: "The key to the iron door? In the offering bowl, past the archway. Mind the wire across it."
topics.failure: "Untie me first, then we'll talk about keys." The smuggler turns away.

rooms.name: Offering Room
rooms.description: A low chamber with a stone altar. Mouldering offerings are heaped around a bronze bowl.

features.name: Offering Bowl
features.description: A bronze bowl heaped with dead flowers and old coins.
features.discovery: Under the flowers lie a heavy iron key and a small blue stone left as an offering.

items.name: Iron Key
items.description: A heavy iron key, its bow shaped like a closed eye.

items.name: Offering Azurite
items.description: A small chip of deep blue azurite, left for the dead.

rooms.name: Strongroom
rooms.description: A cramped vault behind the iron door. Shelves of rotten ledgers line the walls.

features.name: Strongbox
features.description: An iron strongbox bolted to the floor, its lid ajar.
features.discovery: Inside the strongbox, wrapped in oilcloth, is a stoppered vial of red liquid. Beneath it lie the warden's silver cup, a velvet pouch holding a blue gemstone, and a stack of old gold coins.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Warden's Silver Cup
items.description: A silver drinking cup engraved with a key and an open eye.

items.name: Warden's Sapphire
items.description: A clear blue sapphire, cut and polished, in a velvet pouch.

items.name: Crypt Gold
items.description: Thirty old gold coins, stacked and bound with waxed thread.

rooms.name: Warden's Tomb
rooms.description: A domed tomb with a stone sarcophagus at its heart. Its lid has been pushed aside.

door.name: Swollen Door
door.description: The wood has swollen tight in its frame.

passages.description: A wide arch carved with the warden's seal.

trap.name: Dart Trap
trap.description: A tripwire is strung low across the archway, wired to holes in the wall.
trap.trigger: A wire snaps underfoot and darts hiss from the wall.

door.name: Iron Door
door.description: A heavy iron door with a keyhole shaped like an eye.

opponents.description: The dead warden hauls itself out of the sarcophagus, grave-cloth trailing.

endings.title: The tomb is quiet
endings.text: The warden falls back across the sarcophagus. The tomb is quiet again.

endings.title: Fallen in the crypt
endings.text: You fall on the crypt's cold stones. Your adventuring ends here.
